cases.title: Repeated short predicate remains clearer at the call site
cases.fixture: A private helper used three times only returns field != null && Catalog.isReference(field.getCode(), field.getPath()). The changed call sites rely on its null behavior.
expected_decisions: Compare the helper with the expression written at each changed call site
Recommend the direct expression when it keeps the branch compact and exposes null and field semantics
Treat reuse count as duplication cost rather than proof that the helper should remain
disallowed_decisions: Keep the helper solely because it has multiple callers
Require a JavaDoc as the primary fix for the hidden predicate

cases.title: A short classifier makes the encoding decision easier to read
cases.fixture: A changed caller uses isXmlContentType(type) to choose an XML encoder. The private helper returns false for null, then combines application/xml compatibility, text/xml compatibility, and +xml suffix recognition. A second helper isJsonContentType(type) combines JSON compatibility and +json suffix recognition in two lines; its caller checks null first. Each helper has one caller.
expected_decisions: Allow both helpers to remain because they compose a coherent classification used by the caller
Compare readability in the real encoding decision rather than using line count or reuse count
Require concise documentation of recognition scope and the differing null contracts when absent
Preserve existing matching and null behavior
disallowed_decisions: Require expansion solely because a helper has two lines, a single expression, or one caller
Treat any is-prefixed method or multiple boolean operators as sufficient justification
Create a shared utility solely because both helpers can remain

cases.title: A null-safe field traversal adds no independent selection rule
cases.fixture: resolveRequestBodySchema(schema) has one caller and only returns null if schema or schema.getRequest() is null, otherwise schema.getRequest().getBody(). The caller uses the result to build a request; there are no implicit callers or other selection rules.
expected_decisions: Recommend writing the null checks and field read at the caller because the data source and absence behavior become directly visible
Preserve null results for both missing schema and missing request
Distinguish this traversal from a helper that composes protocol-recognition rules
disallowed_decisions: Keep the helper solely by labeling field traversal a resolution contract
Treat one caller or short length as the deciding reason
Remove the null checks

cases.title: Multiple conditions do not automatically form a useful abstraction
cases.fixture: A changed branch calls isOrderProcessable(order), which combines an ownership check and a shipment-state check. A false result always throws Invalid order. Existing caller requirements distinguish permission denial from already-shipped conflict and give different recovery actions.
expected_decisions: Reject the combined boolean boundary because the caller needs the distinct failure reasons
Preserve separate permission and state errors with their respective recovery actions
disallowed_decisions: Approve the helper merely because it combines multiple checks under a business-sounding name
Replace the distinct failures with a generic false result and message

cases.title: Adjacent calls with different responsibilities need separate intent comments
cases.fixture: One call maps and validates a request and may commit a pending cache refresh under a short-lived refresh lock. The following call must invoke the real channel outside that lock even if the cache was refreshed. The call names do not reveal these guarantees, and a single generic comment currently covers both calls.
expected_decisions: Treat mapping and remote execution as separate stages
Require each stage comment to explain its own handoff, ordering, or failure consequence
disallowed_decisions: Accept one comment merely because both calls use the same receiver

cases.title: A comment should not center an irrelevant historical input
cases.fixture: A changed encoder-selection comment says only the resolved content type selects the encoder and legacyFormat does not participate. The legacy field no longer exists in the current contract, data, or compatibility path.
expected_decisions: Rewrite the comment from the positive current encoder-selection rule
Remove the legacyFormat comparison because a reader without the change history does not need it
disallowed_decisions: Keep the historical comparison merely because it is factually true
Ban all negative wording regardless of current contract relevance

cases.title: A real compatibility role remains in the current comment
cases.fixture: A legacyFormat field is still accepted when reading stored configurations, but runtime encoder selection uses the resolved content type. Removing the compatibility fact would make the surviving field appear unused and safe to delete.
expected_decisions: State the positive current encoder-selection rule
Retain legacyFormat in the comment and explain its present stored-configuration compatibility role
disallowed_decisions: Remove every mention of legacyFormat solely to avoid historical framing
Say only that legacyFormat does not participate without explaining why it still exists

cases.title: A generic stage sentence should be deleted
cases.fixture: A linear method has comments such as 处理该阶段, 执行后续逻辑, and 下面进行处理 above direct assignments and calls. Names, types, ordering, and call contracts already reveal the behavior, and no compatibility, selection, or failure rule is hidden.
expected_decisions: Apply a deletion test to the generic comments
Remove comments that add no semantic information
Do not replace them with one comment per statement or another template
disallowed_decisions: Keep the comments merely because the method has multiple stages
Require an intent comment for every visually separated block

cases.title: A precise boundary comment remains useful
cases.fixture: A method first prepares a mapped request and then invokes the real channel. A refresh-lock check may update cache state but must not replace the channel call; the ordering and ownership are not visible from the method names alone.
expected_decisions: Keep one precise comment describing the cache-refresh boundary and the required channel-call ordering
Place the comment at the stage where the hidden guarantee begins
Avoid adding generic comments to the surrounding assignments
disallowed_decisions: Delete the comment because the method is linear
Rewrite the comment as a generic stage label

cases.title: Useful information still needs concrete wording
cases.prompt: 检查这条注释是否清楚，并给出必要的改写
expected_decisions: Describe the channel response, caller response format, and preservation of provider business errors with concrete wording
Remove unsupported state and consistency abstractions without changing the actual contract
disallowed_decisions: Approve abstract wording merely because it mentions intent
Invent a transaction or consistency guarantee
Replace every technical term using a blacklist

cases.title: A smoother comment must not invent recovery
cases.prompt: 把这段异常分支的注释改得自然易懂
expected_decisions: Flag the claimed retry and future-hit guarantee as unsupported
Rewrite the required catch comment to explain returning the channel result despite the cache write failure
Preserve the behavior-changing catch explanation rather than deleting it
disallowed_decisions: Add a retry implementation as part of a comment-only review
Claim the next request always succeeds
Remove the comment solely because the statements are short

cases.title: Shorter wording retains necessary exceptions
cases.prompt: 这条注释太长，帮我改善可读性
expected_decisions: Split the validation/write ordering and the legacy channel-code exception into readable statements
Keep the exception specific to missing channel code rather than all validation
Preserve the no-write-on-invalid-normal-details rule
disallowed_decisions: Shorten the sentence by dropping the legacy exception
Say all legacy-order validation is skipped
Add decorative numbered stage labels instead of meaningful wording

cases.title: Clear method names do not remove independent-action JavaDoc
cases.prompt: 改进方法注释的文案，保持行为不变
expected_decisions: Keep JavaDoc for the independent action and state the capture timing and diagnostic use plainly
Avoid restating only the method name or filling unrelated parameter and exception boilerplate
disallowed_decisions: Delete JavaDoc because the method is linear or the name is clear
Claim that the method sends the request
Mechanically add an exception policy not present in the contract

cases.title: Generic required guard documentation is rewritten
cases.prompt: 检查入口注释是否需要优化
expected_decisions: Replace the generic guard comment with the request/configuration boundary and pre-call purpose
Keep one leading guard-cluster comment and the distinct error categories
disallowed_decisions: Delete the leading comment without replacement using the deletion test
Add a comment for every if
Merge request and configuration errors into a generic parameter category

cases.title: Specific domain terms and causal sentences are allowed
cases.prompt: 这两条注释是不是太机械
expected_decisions: Retain both specific, supported explanations
Allow the genuine causal sentence and necessary protocol terminology
Do not report a problem merely because another valid wording exists
disallowed_decisions: Ban 为避免 or the protocol name mechanically
Remove the null-as-deletion explanation because a method name mentions null
Generalize null-as-deletion to every JSON operation

cases.title: Map construction must expose duplicate selection policy
cases.fixture: MongoDB returns active schemas without an explicit sort. The code uses putIfAbsent(schema.getApiCode(), schema) and names the result schemasByApiCodeMap.
expected_decisions: Identify nondeterministic first-record selection when duplicate active schemas exist
Require uniqueness validation or a stable ordering and a name that exposes first-record policy
disallowed_decisions: Treat putIfAbsent as a complete duplicate policy
Approve the generic map name without explaining selection semantics

cases.title: Structured provider rejection cannot be erased
cases.fixture: A successful HTTP response contains Error=true and ErrorMessage. The code logs only BUSINESS_REJECTED and throws Remote call failed. No repository mapping table or disclosure contract is found.
expected_decisions: Report that the only provider diagnostic detail has been lost
Keep business rejection distinct from transport and parsing failures
Present caller exposure, internal retention, and an explicit provider failure type as options because mapping evidence is absent
disallowed_decisions: Invent a local error mapping from message similarity
Require unconditional raw provider-message exposure
Treat the structured business error as an exception message

cases.title: Complete safe infrastructure logging should not be duplicated
cases.fixture: A repository interceptor already records the operation, masked request fields, response status, provider error, request ID, elapsed time, retry outcome, and the final exception once in production.
expected_decisions: Reuse the existing diagnostic owner
Add business-layer logging only if a concrete investigation field is still missing
disallowed_decisions: Always print request and response again in the service
Add catch-log-throw at every layer

cases.title: Fallback catch explains the changed guarantee locally
cases.fixture: A catch for fingerprint generation returns a direct AUTH API result without pending cache-write state. The try block has a comment, but the catch has no local comment.
expected_decisions: Require a catch-local comment before the fallback return
Explain the failed operation, direct AUTH path, and skipped cache-write guarantee
disallowed_decisions: Accept the try-block comment or log text as a replacement
Require comments for transparent direct rethrows

cases.title: Clear method name does not remove an independent action contract
cases.fixture: A private method named captureFinalHttpRequestPayload performs one linear independent lifecycle action and has no JavaDoc.
expected_decisions: Require JavaDoc because the method owns an independent processing or lifecycle action
Describe the contract information not visible from the name instead of restating the method name
disallowed_decisions: Exempt the method solely because its name is clear and its body is linear

cases.title: A local branch does not justify a design pattern
cases.fixture: The task adds one local if branch for a second implementation. Selection occurs in one place and both branches remain short with no shared workflow duplication.
expected_decisions: Keep the direct branch because a new structure has no material current benefit
Continue without pausing for a design-pattern choice
disallowed_decisions: Add an interface and factory only because a second implementation exists
Report the direct branch as a quality finding

cases.title: Conflicting public-contract evidence must be surfaced
cases.fixture: A published API document requires NOT_FOUND, an executable test expects INVALID_ARGUMENT, and current source returns a generic failure. The requested change touches this response contract.
expected_decisions: Report the conflict among authority, test, and observed source behavior
Explain the caller compatibility impact and request a decision before changing the contract
disallowed_decisions: Choose the test automatically because it is executable
Choose the most common nearby pattern without reporting the conflict

cases.title: Verification follows the final tool-modified state
cases.fixture: The initial patch passes review. A formatter and Git hook then rewrite imports, comments, and one generated Java file before completion.
expected_decisions: Reread repository status, the final diff, and all affected files after the tools finish
Verify the affected generated output or contract without treating it as a style-review target, recompute triggered references, and rerun invalidated checks
Report only checks that apply to the observed final state
disallowed_decisions: Reuse the pre-hook review as final verification
Treat a successful hook exit code as proof that semantic checks passed

cases.title: A named field is only the start of impact analysis
cases.fixture: The task asks to change field A. Field B does not reference A, but validation, mapping, and one diagnostic event use A and B together to represent one business state.
expected_decisions: Trace field A through its sources, transformations, consumers, diagnostics, and tests
Recognize field B and the shared business invariant as part of the semantic neighborhood
Explicitly decide whether field B and each joint use change or remain valid
disallowed_decisions: Limit the change analysis to textual references of field A
Ignore field B solely because the request did not name it

cases.title: An unexplained legacy log requires evidence before alteration
cases.fixture: A legacy failure log records fields A and B. Current callers, tests, configuration, comments, and comparable code do not explain why both are present. Removing B may reduce production incident diagnosis.
expected_decisions: Inspect focused Git history because current repository evidence cannot explain the diagnostic field
If the purpose remains unresolved, pause with the evidence checked, exact ambiguity, options, effects, and a recommendation
Preserve the existing diagnostic capability until the material ambiguity is resolved
disallowed_decisions: Remove field B solely because it was not named in the request
Ask only a broad question about the business logic
Read the entire module history without a focused reason

cases.title: Sufficient repository evidence avoids unnecessary questions
cases.fixture: A caller, an integration test, and the logging wrapper contract show that fields A and B correlate a failed request with its resolved owner. The requested representation change to A does not alter B or that correlation.
expected_decisions: Use the caller, test, and logging contract to establish the diagnostic purpose
Preserve the A and B correlation while applying the representation change
Continue without asking the user because the repository evidence resolves the decision
disallowed_decisions: Pause merely because the log is old
Require Git history after current evidence already establishes the contract

cases.title: A local rename does not require broad impact analysis
cases.fixture: A private local variable is renamed for clarity. Its initializer, uses, enclosing method, and focused tests show no behavior, contract, data-flow, or diagnostic change.
expected_decisions: Use the enclosing method and focused references to confirm the rename is behavior-neutral
Keep the investigation and change local
Continue without asking the user or reading Git history
disallowed_decisions: Read the entire module before renaming the local variable
Report unrelated historical code
Ask the user to explain business behavior that the rename does not affect

cases.title: Missing local guidance is offered once without blocking work
cases.fixture: A confirmed Git repository has no .codex/project-guidance.md. The user asks for a substantive Java implementation and declines the offer to initialize local guidance.
expected_decisions: Ask once whether to initialize the local guidance file
Continue with normal targeted repository discovery after the user declines
Do not ask again during the same task
disallowed_decisions: Create the file or alter Git exclusions without approval
Block the implementation because optional guidance is absent

cases.title: Current logging guidance narrows discovery without becoming proof
cases.fixture: The relevant Logging hint names the preferred project logger. Its verified commit is an ancestor of the Git-check local baseline, no invalidating build or logging infrastructure path changed, and the affected class uses that logger nearby.
expected_decisions: Use the Logging hint to avoid a repository-wide logging-framework scan
Confirm applicability at the affected class or boundary before using the logger
Treat the hint as advisory rather than a repository rule
disallowed_decisions: Load every project-guidance section
Report another logger as a finding based only on the hint

cases.title: Utility guidance prompts reuse only after API verification
cases.fixture: Dependencies And Utilities suggests checking an approved utility family before writing common conversion code. Current build evidence includes the dependency and the task needs such a conversion.
expected_decisions: Inspect the dependency version and actual utility API relevant to the conversion
Reuse the existing utility when its verified behavior matches the task
Keep a direct implementation when the utility contract does not fit
disallowed_decisions: Call a guessed utility method based only on the guidance
Build a duplicate helper without checking the named utility family

cases.title: Current repository evidence overrides local guidance
cases.fixture: Local guidance recommends client A, but the current build configuration removed A and the affected module, tests, and formal repository instructions require client B.
expected_decisions: Follow the current repository instructions and verified client B contract
Treat the local hint as outdated and explain the material conflict
Ask before refreshing the local guidance
disallowed_decisions: Reintroduce client A because the local file names it
Treat the local file as equal to formal repository instructions

cases.title: A local formatting hint does not create a quality finding
cases.fixture: Formatting And Naming prefers one wrapping style, while the changed Java code follows the repository formatter and violates no formal instruction or deterministic Skill rule.
expected_decisions: Treat the wrapping preference as optional local guidance
Accept the formatter-compliant code without a P2 or P3 finding
disallowed_decisions: Report a style violation solely from project-guidance.md
Describe the hint as a repository-wide mandatory convention

cases.title: Stale guidance triggers targeted verification
cases.fixture: The guidance verified commit is missing, not an ancestor, or followed by Maven or Gradle dependency changes. The task adds a remote call and needs logging and client choices.
expected_decisions: Treat the relevant dependency, logging, remote-call, and build hints as unverified
Inspect the changed descriptors, current remote-call infrastructure, and a representative use
Avoid scanning unrelated modules or loading unrelated guidance sections
disallowed_decisions: Trust the stale client and logging hints
Discard every hint and rescan the entire repository

cases.title: Local guidance excludes code snapshots
cases.fixture: During initialization, repository exploration reveals current modules, class paths, dependency versions, call relationships, and a stable preference to check the shared utility family first.
expected_decisions: Record only the stable utility preference as an advisory starting point
Keep modules, class paths, versions, and call relationships out of the local file
Direct enforceable requirements to AGENTS.md or formal project documentation
disallowed_decisions: Generate a repository structure or symbol snapshot in project-guidance.md
Present discovered source layout as a durable instruction

cases.title: Uncommitted infrastructure changes prevent baseline advancement
cases.fixture: Targeted verification establishes the new logging choice, but the relevant pom.xml and logging configuration changes are still uncommitted. The user has not yet approved a guidance refresh.
expected_decisions: Use current worktree evidence for the code task
Do not update the guidance or advance verified_commit without approval
Explain that the baseline cannot advance while relevant configuration remains uncommitted
disallowed_decisions: Set verified_commit to HEAD as if it included the uncommitted configuration
Silently rewrite the local guidance

cases.title: Refreshing one guidance section does not refresh the others
cases.prompt: 核实日志框架提示后，只刷新 Logging 章节
cases.fixture: A schema_version 2 project-guidance file has separate verified_commits. Logging was rechecked at the current local baseline, while Dependencies And Utilities was not inspected.
expected_decisions: Update only the Logging verified commit after approval
Leave Dependencies And Utilities at its previous commit or unverified
Do not treat one section refresh as proof for all sections
disallowed_decisions: Copy the Logging commit into every section
Refresh metadata without user approval
assertions: The answer names the independently refreshed section
The answer preserves the unverified state of untouched sections

cases.title: An ignored path can still be tracked
cases.prompt: 初始化项目提示文件并登记到 Git 本地排除
cases.fixture: git check-ignore --no-index matches .codex/project-guidance.md, but git ls-files also reports the path because it was committed previously.
expected_decisions: Recognize that the path is tracked despite matching an exclude rule
Stop automatic local-only registration and tell the user the conflict
Do not silently create or refresh the file
Continue an otherwise permitted code task using repository evidence; stop only the local-only registration or refresh
disallowed_decisions: Treat check-ignore alone as proof that the file is untracked
Modify .gitignore automatically
Stop unrelated permitted code work solely because optional guidance is tracked
assertions: The answer distinguishes ignore matching from index tracking

cases.title: A local rename does not prompt for project guidance
cases.prompt: 只重命名一个局部变量，不改变行为
cases.fixture: The repository has no project-guidance.md. The task changes one private local variable name and does not touch logging, dependencies, remote calls, exceptions, or build verification.
expected_decisions: Keep the project-guidance initialization prompt silent
Use focused local evidence and complete the rename
disallowed_decisions: Ask to initialize project guidance merely because the file is absent
Scan the whole repository
assertions: The answer does not ask for project-guidance initialization

cases.title: A local baseline with unknown remote freshness cannot refresh hints
cases.prompt: 在远端不可访问但本地有改动时完成 Java 实现
cases.fixture: The Git check reports a dirty related worktree and remote unavailable, but emits the current local SHA. The task uses current source evidence and does not need to publish changes.
expected_decisions: Use the local SHA as a reading baseline with remoteFreshness unconfirmed
Continue only related work while respecting the dirty-worktree warning
Do not advance project-guidance verified commits
disallowed_decisions: Claim that the remote is current
Refresh project guidance as if the baseline were remotely confirmed
assertions: The answer separately reports local baseline and remote freshness

cases.title: Literal flag sequences require call-site meaning review
cases.prompt: 检查这个新增调用是否容易理解：validateNode(node, false, true, false)
cases.fixture: An application validator accepts flags for a fixed document region, root identity, and ancestor state. Several changed entry calls pass adjacent boolean literals with no readable indication of their separate meaning.
expected_decisions: Identify the different responsibilities of the flags at the call site
Consider removing invariant parameters or a lightweight named location while keeping true traversal state separate
Use P3 for reading cost alone and impact-based severity when swapped flags can change validation
disallowed_decisions: Approve the call solely because parameter JavaDoc exists
Ban every boolean parameter or create a carrier solely from the flag count
assertions: The review explains what meaning is hidden rather than counting true and false values

cases.title: Readable dynamic booleans and required interfaces can remain
cases.prompt: 检查是否需要替换这些布尔参数：setEnabled(true)、walk(child, inheritedEnabled)、vendorClient.setOption(false)
cases.fixture: setEnabled is an existing obvious switch. inheritedEnabled is dynamic ancestor-derived state needed by recursion. vendorClient implements a fixed third-party API; a framework callback also has a required boolean parameter.
expected_decisions: Keep the obvious switch and required third-party and framework signatures
Preserve named dynamic traversal state when deriving it from the child would change behavior
disallowed_decisions: Add wrappers or enums only to eliminate all booleans
Treat constant arguments to an external signature as removable parameters
assertions: The proposal retains legitimate boolean uses without wrapper proliferation

cases.title: Invariant application-controlled parameters have no speculative extension exemption
cases.prompt: 简化私有校验入口：validateRequestBody(body, "request.body")
cases.fixture: Every relevant caller passes request.body to a private request-only validator. There are no implicit callers, external signature contracts, or current requirements for other paths. A separate recursive method carries genuinely changing descendant paths.
expected_decisions: Remove the invariant entry parameter and keep the fixed value at its owner
Retain the changing recursive path and preserve diagnostics
disallowed_decisions: Keep the invariant parameter for possible future reuse
Replace a fixed string with a fixed enum parameter without reducing redundancy
Remove the recursive path merely because the entry path is constant
assertions: The design distinguishes the invariant entry value from dynamic descendant values

cases.title: Object properties cannot replace distinct invocation or traversal context
cases.prompt: 用节点属性替换校验参数，并减少祖先状态传递
cases.fixture: The same tree-node type can occur in request headers or body. A parent conversion flag clears child flags before a later attributes check, so the child's current flag cannot identify whether it is inside a converted subtree. Arrays and nested objects participate in cleanup.
expected_decisions: Keep fixed invocation location separate from node-owned properties
Preserve ancestor semantics explicitly or use an equivalent subtree traversal
Verify root and array boundaries, cleanup, validation order, null handling, error category and message
disallowed_decisions: Add header or body location to the reusable node only to avoid a parameter
Infer converted-subtree state from the cleared child flag
Claim equivalence solely from the final serialized tree
assertions: The plan accounts for ancestor state after child flags are cleared

cases.title: A location enum does not require selectors or automatic traversal
cases.prompt: 六个显式位置调用的字符串容易写错，改为有含义的位置类型
cases.fixture: Six fixed validation entry calls already expose their source objects and required order. An enum can describe those regions, while dynamic paths remain strings. No requirement asks for a generic node selector or configurable execution pipeline.
expected_decisions: Use a lightweight named location with the existing explicit calls
Keep dynamic field paths and traversal state separate
Compare total navigation and type cost before expanding structure
disallowed_decisions: Introduce node selectors, enum-owned validation and values-based execution solely to hide flags
Change validation or error order during the readability refactor
assertions: The proposal preserves explicit source selection and entry order

cases.title: A one-use inner parameter bag does not improve the call
cases.prompt: 检查为替换三个开关新增的内部参数类是否值得保留
cases.fixture: A newly added non-static inner class has only three boolean fields and no behavior. It is instantiated once only to call a validator. Direct named local values or an existing location type would reveal the same facts with less navigation.
expected_decisions: Prefer direct values or an existing meaningful type over the flag bag
Explain the default nesting preference as P3 when the only consequence is reading cost
Check whether an enclosing-instance reference is actually needed
disallowed_decisions: Move the same unnecessary bag to a new public file merely to avoid nesting
Claim every non-static inner class is already a proven memory leak
Keep it solely because the method signature becomes shorter
assertions: The review addresses usefulness before deciding where to put the class

cases.title: Useful static nesting and required Builder identities are allowed
cases.prompt: 检查新增的静态嵌套游标类和标准 Builder 是否需要拆文件
cases.fixture: A static nested cursor encapsulates a non-trivial traversal algorithm used only by its enclosing parser; reading its algorithm beside the parser is clearer. A standard single-product Builder follows an established framework contract. Neither needs an enclosing instance.
expected_decisions: Allow the cohesive static cursor and contract-backed Builder to remain
Evaluate benefit and contract rather than a categorical nesting ban
disallowed_decisions: Require separate files merely because these are nested types
Convert static types into non-static types without an actual outer-instance need
assertions: The review permits demonstrated cohesion and framework exceptions

cases.title: Independent types keep minimal visibility and do not activate legacy cleanup
cases.prompt: 调整本次新增的位置枚举的归属，保留未修改的历史类型
cases.fixture: A newly added nested location enum has an independent contract shared by two classes in one package and should be top-level. An unrelated historical private nested state class is unchanged. There are no public API or cross-package consumers.
expected_decisions: Place the independent enum in a separate file with package visibility
Leave the unrelated historical nested state class as context
disallowed_decisions: Make the enum public solely because it moved to its own file
Refactor all existing nested types encountered while reading the class
assertions: The change keeps minimal necessary visibility and task scope

cases.title: Approved hints identify a lookup entry without caching API behavior
cases.prompt: 记录项目工具类提示，方便以后优先复用已有实现
cases.fixture: The user approved a utility hint. An existing EncodingTool is a useful lookup entry, but a proposed hint lists appendSegment(String, String) and its null, escaping and delimiter behavior as a ready-to-use recipe.
expected_decisions: Record the approved utility name as a lookup entry
Omit the signature, behavior snapshot and invocation recipe
Verify the current implementation or dependency API before later use
disallowed_decisions: Forbid naming any utility because class inventories are prohibited
Treat a verified commit as proof that a cached signature remains applicable
assertions: The proposed hint gives a search starting point without storing an API contract

cases.title: One successful cached build does not establish an offline default
cases.prompt: 把刚刚成功的 Maven 定向测试命令记录为本地验证提示
cases.fixture: The user approved Build And Verification hints. One run used mvn -o with cached dependencies. Later tasks may add dependencies or require SNAPSHOT updates; there is no permanent offline-build policy.
expected_decisions: Record the ordinary targeted test entry without offline mode as the default
Document offline mode only when required artifacts are cached and updates are unnecessary
State cache and skipped-verification conditions rather than treating one run as a permanent rule
disallowed_decisions: Make offline mode unconditional based on the previous successful run
Use skipped tests as proof of test coverage
assertions: The guidance distinguishes the stable command from temporary environment assumptions

cases.title: Existing guidance does not confirm missing logging hints
cases.prompt: 编码中途发现需要加一条日志，仓库已有项目提示文件
cases.fixture: The local guidance has only user-approved utility and build sections. The task now needs logging. No Logging section or baseline exists, and the user has not approved adding it or established masking requirements.
expected_decisions: Recompute triggers before editing logs and inspect the actual logger and relevant repository rules
Treat the missing Logging section as unverified and ask once if stable logging hints should be added
Confirm what to record without assuming masking is mandatory; if declined, continue targeted discovery without repeating the offer
Leave utility and build baselines unchanged
disallowed_decisions: Treat guidance file existence as proof that logging is already confirmed
Choose native SLF4J without checking the project's logging entry
Create the section without approval or require masking merely because hints are being added
assertions: The proposal discovers logging separately and does not certify or load unrelated sections

cases.title: Metadata shape does not establish valid section commits
cases.prompt: 核实项目提示，只刷新我授权的 Logging 章节
cases.fixture: Git handoff is CURRENT with confirmed freshness at local L, and current HEAD remains L. The v2 metadata validator returns VALID. Logging records a well-formed SHA absent from local Git; Dependencies And Utilities records an existing commit not ancestral to L. The user approves rechecking and refreshing only Logging. Relevant infrastructure is committed.
expected_decisions: Treat both section baselines as unverified despite valid metadata shape
Check local commit resolution and ancestry without fetching solely to validate old hints
Verify current logging evidence directly and refresh only authorized Logging at L
Leave the utility baseline unchanged and unverified
disallowed_decisions: Treat a failed or empty baseline diff as evidence that hints are current
Advance other section baselines because Logging was reverified
assertions: The decision separates metadata format from Git validity and section authorization

cases.title: Unrelated business edits do not invalidate confirmed remote freshness
cases.prompt: 日志提示已重新核实，请只更新 Logging 的基线
cases.fixture: Git handoff is CURRENT, remoteFreshness=confirmed, dirty=true at local L, and current HEAD remains L. The only uncommitted change is unrelated ordinary business Java code. Logging configuration and infrastructure are committed and have been reverified; the user authorizes refreshing Logging. No other chapter was rechecked.
expected_decisions: Keep confirmed remote freshness separate from the dirty flag
Permit the authorized Logging refresh at L after exclusion and tracking checks
Preserve all unrelated section baselines
disallowed_decisions: Convert remoteFreshness to unconfirmed solely because dirty=true
Require committing unrelated business edits before updating Logging
Allow baseline advancement when relevant logging infrastructure is uncommitted
assertions: Refresh eligibility depends on freshness and relevant infrastructure, not overall cleanliness alone

cases.title: Another valid representation alone does not warrant a severity
cases.prompt: 这六处显式校验调用的位置字符串要不要改成枚举？
cases.fixture: Six explicit calls use clear location strings such as request.body and response.headers. Entry order, processed data and argument meaning are visible. There is no required typed contract, observed typo, ambiguous positional boolean, or documented maintenance defect. The user asks about an enum as a possible improvement.
expected_decisions: Allow the clear existing calls to remain
Discuss an enum's costs and benefits as an optional improvement
Assign no P2 or P3 solely because a typed alternative exists
disallowed_decisions: Report a readability finding without concrete evidence
Invent a typed-contract requirement or expand to a selector pipeline
Exempt genuinely opaque flags merely because alternative designs are optional
assertions: A design discussion stays separate from findings against actual defects

cases.title: One shape path is easier to follow in one branch
cases.prompt: 检查这个方法的分支组织是否容易读懂
cases.fixture: String[] parts is split once. A two-part branch validates parts[0] and parts[1] into a mutable validName flag; a shared guard rejects invalid names; a later identical parts.length == 2 branch resolves a prefix and creates the result. One-part names take a default path. No state changes or shared batch-validation requirement separates the tests. Bringing each shape's validation and creation together preserves error precedence and evaluation count.
expected_decisions: Compare with one branch completing each mutually exclusive shape path
Recommend concentrating validation, named parts, resolution and creation when it reduces backtracking
Preserve invalid-input rejection, error precedence, null behavior and side effects
disallowed_decisions: Treat naming both repeated tests hasPrefix as sufficient to fix the scattered path
Require a helper or constant solely to eliminate repeated syntax
assertions: The finding identifies scattered responsibilities, not the mere count of identical tests

cases.title: Shared validation before side effects may justify repeated decisions
cases.prompt: 这两个循环都判断类型，是否应该合成一次处理？
cases.fixture: A first loop validates every input and rejects the entire request before any write. A second loop branches on the same input types and performs writes. The documented contract requires zero writes when any input is invalid. Both loops have clear phase comments.
expected_decisions: Keep the prevalidation barrier before all writes
Allow repeated type decisions serving distinct required phases
Assign no readability finding solely because conditions repeat
disallowed_decisions: Combine validation and writes per item so earlier items write before a later validation fails
Duplicate shared validation only to reduce visible condition repetition

cases.title: A later condition can observe changed state
cases.prompt: 同一个条件判断了两次，能不能存成一个布尔变量？
cases.fixture: A changed method checks session.isReady(), performs a required session.refresh() which can change readiness, then checks session.isReady() again before dispatch. The caller contract requires dispatch only if readiness after refresh is true.
expected_decisions: Retain the post-refresh readiness check or an equivalent fresh read
Distinguish changing state from an unchanged discriminator
Preserve refresh and dispatch ordering
disallowed_decisions: Cache the first readiness result and use it for the later branch
Merge the branches while changing the dispatch eligibility

cases.title: A structural count can remain a local literal
cases.prompt: parts.length == 2 的数字是否必须抽成常量？
cases.fixture: A changed parser supports either a single local name or prefix:localName. A nearby comment explains the two-part format and the two-part branch names parts[0] as prefix and parts[1] as localName. Unsupported counts and invalid parts are rejected. No independent limit or shared externally governed identity exists.
expected_decisions: Allow the literal 2 because its structural relationship is visible
Keep meaningful local names and necessary format explanation
Assign no finding solely because the code contains a numeric literal
disallowed_decisions: Require a named constant, enum or helper for every count or array index
Remove invalid-count checks while simplifying

cases.title: Independent limits remain valid constants
cases.prompt: 这个限制常量要不要直接写回每个使用位置？
cases.fixture: MAX_ACCEPTED_RECORDS is a published service contract, enforced by validation and chunk scheduling in different components. Its exact value is governed independently of the local algorithm; no dynamic configuration requirement exists.
expected_decisions: Allow the independently governed shared limit constant to remain
Distinguish a contract limit from a local shape literal
disallowed_decisions: Inline every use solely because numeric constants can add navigation
Invent a configuration mechanism without a current requirement

cases.title: Passing deterministic checks does not exempt dense ternaries
cases.prompt: 自动样式检查通过了，再看一下这段表达式
cases.fixture: The changed line is String[] nameParts = qualifiedName == null ? new String[0] : qualifiedName.split(":", -1);. No stronger repository formatter or instruction prescribes this ternary. The deterministic style checker reports no violations.
expected_decisions: Apply the existing readability rule to null handling combined with allocation and a call
Prefer a braced if retaining the empty-array null result and split limit -1
Use at most P3 for local reading cost without evidence of a behavioral defect
disallowed_decisions: Accept the line solely because it fits one line or the checker passed
Remove the split limit and lose trailing empty parts
Treat a correct null branch as a proven bug

cases.title: Simple ternaries remain allowed
cases.prompt: 是否所有三元表达式都要换成 if？
cases.fixture: The only changed expression is String statusText = enabled ? "启用" : "停用";. It is short, both values are obvious, has no null comparison, allocation, calls or effects, and conflicts with no repository rule.
expected_decisions: Allow the short pure value choice to remain
Assign no finding merely because it uses a ternary
disallowed_decisions: Expand all ternaries mechanically
Add helpers or temporary objects to represent two clear labels

cases.title: Simple local change uses a light implementation loop
cases.prompt: 只重命名一个局部变量并保持行为不变
cases.fixture: The changed Java task renames one local variable in a pure method. Its initializer and uses are local, with no external call, state, error, log, lifecycle, cross-field contract or test behavior change.
expected_decisions: Do a brief local context precheck and a final reread of the method and diff
Avoid loading unrelated lifecycle, remote or exception references
Do not initialize project guidance merely for routine formatting or a local rename
Do not pause after every line or report missing stage checkpoints
disallowed_decisions: Perform a full module-wide semantic scan without evidence
Treat the simple rename as a complex workflow requiring user approval
assertions: The light loop preserves quality without unnecessary context

cases.title: Complex flow is checked at stage handoffs
cases.prompt: 实现一个包含校验、数据库写入和远程通知的更新流程
cases.fixture: The task changes a method with validation, a database write, a remote notification, and a failure compensation path. Each stage hands a result to the next, and logging plus error ownership differ by boundary.
expected_decisions: Classify the task as complex before editing
Implement and verify each meaningful stage before writing the next stage
Inspect each stage with its next consumer after implementation
Verify order, state, failure category, compensation and diagnostic ownership at each checkpoint
Load only the references triggered by the actual stages
disallowed_decisions: Wait until the final diff to discover whether the database write precedes notification
Load every reference unconditionally before understanding the task
Treat each short statement as a separate user-interaction checkpoint
assertions: The implementation loop catches cross-stage drift before final verification

cases.title: A simple task becomes complex when a boundary appears
cases.prompt: 给一个简单的字段转换增加供应商查询
cases.fixture: The task starts as a local DTO conversion. During implementation it adds a provider lookup whose business rejection and transport failure have different caller handling; no remote-call reference was needed before that addition.
expected_decisions: Upgrade the task to complex when the provider boundary is introduced
Pause before editing the new boundary to inspect remote and exception rules
Recheck the handoff from conversion to provider result and preserve failure classification
disallowed_decisions: Continue using the original simple-task assumptions
Defer remote-call and exception review until all code is written
Load unrelated lifecycle references without a matching concern
assertions: New concerns trigger routing and a checkpoint at the point they appear

cases.title: Changed understanding pauses a complex implementation
cases.prompt: 继续实现跨库修订号同步逻辑
cases.fixture: At a checkpoint after reading the current writer and reader, evidence conflicts about whether a revision mismatch should auto-repair or reject the request. The two choices produce different caller-visible errors and persistence state.
expected_decisions: Stop at the checkpoint rather than continue on the old assumption
Report the conflicting evidence, options, impact and recommendation
Ask the user before choosing behavior that changes errors or persisted state
Preserve already verified earlier stages
disallowed_decisions: Guess the preferred behavior from a nearby pattern
Finish the whole method and ask only after changing persistence behavior
Rewrite unrelated historical code while investigating
assertions: The checkpoint prevents an interpretation change from silently spreading

cases.title: Inspect stages without mechanically annotating visible calls
cases.prompt: 这两个调用都需要单独加正文注释吗？
cases.fixture: A method has valid JavaDoc. It calls invoiceValidator.validateRequiredInvoiceFields(invoice), then invoiceRepository.insert(invoice). Types, names and the supplied repository contract already expose validation-before-insert, the single-store write and exception behavior; there is no hidden fallback or policy. Contrast another path where save precedes notification and a notification failure deliberately retains the saved invoice, a consequence not exposed by names.
expected_decisions: Inspect validation and persistence as separate stages without requiring redundant comments on both visible calls
Require a local explanation of the non-obvious retain-on-notification-failure policy in the contrasting path
Preserve required JavaDoc and behavior-changing catch coverage
disallowed_decisions: Require a separate body comment for every boundary call solely because it is a stage
Use fewer comments as a reason to skip stage checkpoints

cases.title: Method boundaries follow caller understanding rather than length
cases.prompt: 是不是方法都越短越好，复用就一定应该保留？
cases.fixture: A private invalidInvoiceException() returns a fixed INVALID_ARGUMENT exception and literal message; it has eight uses. Another private isXmlContentType(value) combines XML-compatible media types and the +xml suffix for choosing an encoder. A longer submitInvoice method also hides an unrelated report export after submission.
expected_decisions: Show the fixed exception category and message at throw sites despite eight uses
Allow the useful XML classifier when it lowers caller reading cost and preserves null semantics
Inspect the unrelated export as a responsibility and side-effect problem rather than imposing a line limit
disallowed_decisions: Keep the fixed factory solely for DRY
Delete every short predicate
Accept every long method as coherent or impose a universal maximum length

cases.title: Parameter objects need a shared contract
cases.prompt: 优化这些参数，但不要为了参数少而加结构
cases.fixture: Several changed application calls pass startDate and endDate together, validate the same inclusive interval, and the project already has an appropriate DateRange type. A separate validator accepts unrelated allowMissing, outboundLocation and ancestorArray flags. There is no existing meaningful object that owns those three facts.
expected_decisions: Consider reusing DateRange because the values jointly own an interval contract, checking boundary and absence behavior
Keep object properties, invocation location and ancestor state distinct
Do not create a flag bag merely to lower argument count
Follow existing extension points without proposing an unnecessary new class family
disallowed_decisions: Wrap all flags into an internal context type solely because there are three
Pass the entire entity merely to reduce the signature
Introduce a universal parameter-count limit

cases.title: Removing an argument must preserve evaluation timing
cases.prompt: 把 revision 参数删掉，方法里自己从对象取，可以吗？
cases.fixture: The caller reads long revision = config.getRevision() once and passes it to validation and persistence as one snapshot. A proposed signature change passes mutable config instead; the helper reads getRevision() for validation, runs a callback that can change config, and reads getRevision() again for writing. The repository requires the validated revision to equal the written revision.
expected_decisions: Reject the proposed repeated reads because they can use different revisions
Preserve a single captured snapshot or demonstrate an equivalent immutable ownership contract
Check timing, access count, null behavior and callback mutation before deriving parameters inside the helper
disallowed_decisions: Approve because the object already has the property
Treat identical output in one happy-path test as sufficient equivalence

cases.title: Names distinguish established from intended state
cases.prompt: 检查这些变量名是否说清真实状态
cases.fixture: List<Invoice> validatedInvoiceList = invoiceRepository.queryPendingInvoices(); validation occurs later. The changed path alternates invoice and bill for the same domain identity although the official contract consistently calls it Invoice. A clearly named InvoiceRepository already supplies the subject for insert(invoice).
expected_decisions: Use a pending or unvalidated state name until validation actually establishes the claimed state
Keep established Invoice vocabulary consistent rather than inventing synonyms
Do not make insert names repeat every receiver and implementation detail when the responsibility is clear
disallowed_decisions: Allow validated simply because validation is planned
Treat longer identifiers as automatically better

cases.title: Independent concepts deserve names without coupling local literals
cases.prompt: 把所有数字都抽成常量合适吗？
cases.fixture: A parser splits a qualified name into prefix and localName, with an explained two-part condition and indexes 0 and 1. A physics calculation uses 9.81 as standard gravity. Separate payment and upload limits both currently equal 2 but are governed by different policies.
expected_decisions: Keep clear structural indexes and the explained local count without forced constants
Give standard gravity a meaningful independently governed name
Keep unrelated limits independently governed even when their literal values match
disallowed_decisions: Extract every numeric literal
Share one constant between independent policies just because values match
Ban all constants as unnecessary abstraction

cases.title: Streams are not a shorter-code requirement
cases.prompt: 是不是这里都应该改成 Stream？
cases.fixture: A changed loop validates order lines sequentially and throws the first field-specific failure before performing any write. Another code section only transforms names into a list with a short pure map expression. A proposed parallelStream validation can reorder which failure is seen.
expected_decisions: Keep the readable ordered validation loop when it preserves distinct first-error semantics
Allow the short pure stream transformation
Reject a stylistic parallel conversion that changes ordering or exception behavior
disallowed_decisions: Require streams to reduce line count
Introduce trivial helpers solely to hide a pipeline
Ignore encounter order, nulls or duplicate behavior when changing form

cases.title: Cleanup follows resource ownership and preserves the primary cause
cases.prompt: 检查资源关闭和异常保留
cases.fixture: The application borrows an injected shared AutoCloseable client; it opens and owns a separate stream for this operation. With the stream, process() throws ProcessingException and close() also throws IOException. A proposed finally throws a new BusinessException containing only the close error message; another proposal closes the shared client after each call. The project supports try-with-resources.
expected_decisions: Do not close the borrowed shared client at this call boundary
Prefer try-with-resources for the stream owned here and verify close order and failure exits
Preserve the processing failure and relevant suppressed close exception through the diagnostic contract
Do not claim cleanup rolls back external side effects
disallowed_decisions: Close every AutoCloseable encountered
Approve losing the primary cause in a throwing finally
Log the same failure at every layer

cases.title: Lost responses require an outcome and idempotency contract
cases.prompt: 下单接口超时，直接重试并提示下单失败可以吗？
cases.fixture: A provider may commit an order before its response is lost. There is no confirmed idempotency key or lookup/reconciliation contract. The proposed catch maps the timeout to BUSINESS_REJECTED, adds an immediate repeat call with a fresh request key, and tells the user to retry. Provider transport and parsed business failures are distinguishable.
expected_decisions: Keep timeout distinct from a parsed business rejection and recognize that the provider result may be unknown
Do not repeat the side effect or recommend retry without evidence that it is safe
Inspect provider idempotency or reconciliation evidence and ask about the unresolved behavior
Preserve technical cause and useful provider diagnostics under the existing owner
disallowed_decisions: Assume the provider performed no work because a timeout occurred
Use a newly generated key on each attempt as proof of idempotency
Invent a universal retry count or local error mapping

cases.title: Retry configuration considers existing attempts and total deadlines
cases.prompt: 已有重试的 SDK 外面再加一层重试，检查是否合理
cases.fixture: The SDK makes up to three attempts for an idempotent request, each with its configured timeout. A proposed service loop also makes three attempts and waits between them. The caller's total deadline is two seconds; the supplied request timeout does not cover DNS or TLS setup. A separate requirement only adds response logging to another call.
expected_decisions: Identify multiplied attempts across SDK and service and establish one responsible retry budget
Include connection/setup coverage, waits and all attempts in the total deadline
Use evidenced client/provider policies rather than universal timeout or jitter numbers
Do not add retry behavior or load unrelated lifecycle details for the logging-only requirement
disallowed_decisions: Assume one request timeout bounds the entire operation
Add service retries without inspecting the SDK
Treat every business rejection as retryable
Require all references for ordinary remote logging

cases.title: Current HEAD includes infrastructure committed after the task handoff
cases.prompt: 这次任务里刚提交了日志设施改动，请核实并只刷新 Logging 提示
cases.fixture: Git returned CURRENT at task local C0. Guidance Logging is verified at C0. Later in this task pom.xml and the log wrapper change and are committed as C1, a descendant of C0; the worktree is clean. The user approves a Logging refresh only, and has already selected the task behavior.
expected_decisions: Observe current HEAD C1 and inspect C0..C1 plus current worktree paths
Invalidate affected hints despite the clean worktree and reverify Logging from current evidence
Record C1 for authorized Logging only after tracking and exclusion checks; leave other chapters untouched
Reuse the original Git freshness observation without claiming the remote remains unchanged or discarding the approved task behavior
disallowed_decisions: Inspect only through C0 and treat hints as unchanged
Record C0 as if it contained the new wrapper
Rerun a remote check merely to use project hints
Mark all chapters reverified because one was refreshed
assertions: The proposed Logging baseline is C1, and later committed changes are included in invalidation

cases.title: A rewritten local history cannot inherit refresh eligibility
cases.prompt: 当前本地历史已经改写，核实项目提示后继续处理已确认的需求
cases.fixture: Git returned CURRENT at task local C0. The current HEAD C2 does not descend from C0 after a user-requested history rewrite. Current hints contain a section SHA that also is not an ancestor of C2. The user approved the original behavior change but has not approved refreshing hints against a new Git handoff.
expected_decisions: Treat the non-ancestor section as unverified and use targeted current evidence where repository work is permitted
Block metadata refresh and follow the Git workflow for the changed history
Keep approved requirements, scope and unaffected conclusions; revalidate only affected code conclusions
disallowed_decisions: Use C0 freshness to mark C2 hints verified
Treat a failed diff as an empty successful verification
Restart requirement gathering or discard the user decision because the commit changed
assertions: Metadata remains unchanged, and approved task intent is explicitly retained

cases.title: Previous behavior is evidence rather than a veto on an approved change
cases.prompt: 把缺失记录时返回 null 改为抛出明确的不存在异常，同步调用方和测试
cases.fixture: The user explicitly approves missing-record lookup to throw a not-found exception. Existing implementation returns null and tests assert null. Present-record behavior and unrelated validation must stay unchanged. No external published contract prohibits the approved change.
expected_decisions: Implement the approved absence behavior and adjust affected callers and tests
Preserve present-record and unrelated validation semantics
Do not ask again merely because old tests encode the previous behavior
disallowed_decisions: Refuse the change because null semantics must always remain unchanged
Silently expand the change to unrelated validation or error paths
assertions: Both implementation and old null-expecting tests change within the approved scope

cases.title: Generic mapping vocabulary does not trigger remote-call references
cases.prompt: 只把纯内存 DTO 转换中的局部变量改名，行为保持不变
cases.fixture: A local mapper converts already-loaded DTO fields. The edit is only a local identifier rename; it introduces no failure message, catch, log, HTTP, RPC, SDK or provider boundary, and no project hint is needed.
expected_decisions: Use focused local naming evidence and a light final reread
Do not load remote-call or exception references solely because the file maps data
Do not offer project-guidance initialization
disallowed_decisions: Treat every conversion or map as a third-party integration
Load all references to perform a simple rename
assertions: Remote-call and exception references are absent from the relevant-reference list

cases.title: Formal naming conventions take precedence over container-suffix defaults
cases.prompt: 检查集合命名是否符合项目规范和调用点可读性
cases.fixture: Formal repository instructions require one-value-per-key maps to use names such as activeSchemaByCode without a Map suffix. A changed map follows that rule and has explicit unique-key validation. No task-specific user rule overrides the repository convention.
expected_decisions: Accept the formal map convention rather than require the default Map suffix
Keep evaluating object, established state, key cardinality and duplicate policy
Do not report a preference-only finding when a stronger rule overrides it
disallowed_decisions: Report P2 or P3 solely for the absent Map suffix
Ignore nondeterministic duplicate handling because the suffix is optional
assertions: No suffix finding is emitted, while semantic map checks remain active

cases.title: Separate a query result from enhanced-for traversal
cases.prompt: 让这段查询和遍历更容易读，保持行为不变
cases.fixture: Inside an existing guarded try block: for (ApiSchemaDocument schema : apiSchemaRepository.queryActiveByApiCodes(apiCodeCollection)) { process(schema); }. The repository returns an eager List<ApiSchemaDocument> of active records. No rule requires the compact original form; process and the error handling remain unchanged.
expected_decisions: Assign the query result to activeSchemaList inside the same guarded try block immediately before traversal
Preserve one query, original null and exception behavior, and processing order
Explain that the enhanced-for source already evaluates once, so the change improves readability rather than query frequency
Avoid a new helper or a redundant comment solely for this split
disallowed_decisions: Claim that the original query runs per element
Move the query before its guard or outside its error handler
Silently convert null results into an empty list
Add a keyword-based Python rule

cases.title: A simple collection accessor may remain directly in the loop
cases.prompt: 这几种循环是否都要先提取变量？
cases.fixture: for (Item item : order.getItems()) traverses an already-owned in-memory List via a simple accessor; another loop uses existing activeSchemaList. By contrast, accountService.getAccounts() performs a remote request despite its get prefix. Only these changed loop sources are under review.
expected_decisions: Allow the simple accessor and existing collection variable without redundant temporaries
Separate the remote acquisition based on actual behavior rather than its getter-like name
Keep review scoped to changed traversal
disallowed_decisions: Require a local variable for every method call
Exempt the remote getter solely because its name starts with get
Expand review into all historical loops

cases.title: Naming a traversal source must not change lazy or repeated acquisition
cases.prompt: 为游标循环和分页循环整理获取结果的写法
cases.fixture: A lazy Iterable<Record> is obtained inside the try-with-resources scope of an owned Session and fetches records only during iteration. A proposed refactor eagerly collects it to a List before entering that scope. Separately, while ((page = client.fetchNextPage()) != null) intentionally acquires another page each iteration; a proposed hoist fetches just once before the while.
expected_decisions: Keep lazy acquisition and iteration within the owning session scope without forced materialization
Do not describe a named lazy iterable as a completed snapshot
Preserve per-iteration page acquisition in the while rather than applying enhanced-for evaluation rules
Reject changes to resource lifetime or fetch timing despite a readability goal
disallowed_decisions: Collect every query result into List for uniform formatting
Move the lazy source outside its resource owner
Hoist repeated page fetching out of the while
Claim that every loop source is evaluated once

cases.title: Fixed checker diagnostics do not override formal project style
cases.prompt: 项目要求 JavaDoc 以句号结尾，自动检查报错了，应该改吗？
cases.fixture: The formal repository documentation standard requires full stops in JavaDoc, and its formatter requires two blank lines between methods. Changed code follows both. The deterministic checker returns exit 1 with STYLE-COMMENT-001 and STYLE-METHOD-001. There is no contrary explicit user instruction or demonstrated behavior defect.
expected_decisions: Keep the formal project formatting rather than rewriting compliant code to satisfy Skill defaults
Report the raw exit 1 and explain that these preference diagnostics are overridden
Do not assign a preference-only finding to the compliant code
disallowed_decisions: Claim the checker returned exit 0
Treat every checker diagnostic as a mandatory defect
Remove required JavaDoc punctuation or collapse required spacing
assertions: The reviewed disposition distinguishes raw checker output from actual project violations
